title: Annual registration fee.
bodyText: The department shall assess and collect an annual registration fee of $10 from each operator of aircraft required to be registered under section 261-15.5.
bodyHtml: [§261-15.6]  Annual registration fee.  The department shall assess and collect an annual registration fee of $10 from each operator of aircraft required to be registered under section 261-15.5. [L 1985, c 299, pt of §1]
